title: Finding halves and quarters
keyIdea: A quarter is one of four equal parts; two quarters make a half.

kid: Cut a cake into 4 parts that are all the same size. Each part is a quarter.
Two quarters are as big as one half.
adult: A quarter is one of four equal parts, so it is half of a half. Fold a paper square in half, then in half again, and you get quarters.
For groups, find a quarter by sharing between four: a quarter of 12 is 3. Two quarters equal one half, which is a first taste of equivalent fractions.

familyTip: Fold a paper square into quarters. Shade one quarter, then two. Is two quarters the same as half?

practice.prompt: A pie is cut into 4 equal parts. One part is…
practice.explain: One of four equal parts is a quarter.

practice.prompt: How many quarters make a half?

pool.prompt: A quarter of {=4*n} cars is how many?
How many quarters make a whole?
Mia eats 2 quarters of a pizza cut into 4. How many slices are left?

pool.explain: A half is two quarters, so it is bigger.

pool.prompt: Ben has {=4*n} sweets and gives away a quarter. How many does he give away?
A square is cut into 4 parts of different sizes. Is each a quarter?
pool.explain: Quarters must all be the same size.

pool.prompt: Two quarters of a cake are the same as…
pool.explain: 2 of 4 equal parts is a half.
